_comment: INLINESYNC-1 baseline -- shields already-known, reviewed legacy inline-copy variants from the sync gate, same ratchet doctrine as scripts/copy-hallmarks-baseline.json: a file listed here may carry its pinned variant text for that pair, but the pinned `files` list is the ceiling -- it only ever shrinks (a file swept to the canonical SSOT text drops off the list; a file NOT already listed here must byte-match the SSOT exactly, so no new hand-typed variant can join). This file shields STYLE variance only, never a behavioral/output difference -- see the ocgCanon note below.

variants.reason: Pre-fix-hash-scheme.mjs ES5 function-expression transcription of the same recursive key-sort canonicalizer (reduce(function(o,k){...return o;},{}) instead of the current arrow-fn reduce). Measured functionally identical to the canonical form for every input shape: both recurse arrays via map, sort object keys, and build the same accumulator object -- the only difference is callback syntax, not behavior or output. Predates fix-hash-scheme.mjs's canonical injection; these chaingraph/chains/*.html pages were generated by an earlier revision of scripts/gen-chain-runners.mjs (current revision emits the canonical arrow form) and were never regenerated. Sweeping these 33 files to the canonical text is a follow-up (page edits are out of INLINESYNC-1's fence), not remediated here.
